newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian bourse suspends trading in insurance firm.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian bourse suspends trading in insurance firm.

text.p: Trading in Shares of British American Insurance Company (BAICO) was suspended on Wednesday because its auditors had queried the company's accounts, the Nigerian stock exchange said.
A senior official of the exchange, Lance Elakhama, told traders the bourse would investigate the matter.
"Trading is suspended until the issue is resolved," he said. He did not say what the query to the account was.
BAICO shares closed at 1.68 naira on Tuesday.
